descriptionByLocale.it:
Logitech è il Sweet Spot per le persone che vogliono che le loro azioni abbiano un impatto globale positivo, pur avendo la flessibilità di farlo a modo loro. Il ruolo e il team: Stiamo cercando un assistente esecutivo esperto, altamente organizzato e proattivo per sostenere il Chief Commercial Officer, con sede a Zurigo. Questo è un ruolo altamente visibile che combina il supporto esecutivo e le operazioni aziendali. Come partner affidabile per il CCO e il Team Leadership, si svolgerà un ruolo chiave nel consentire l'efficacia della leadership, guidare l'eccellenza operativa e sostenere l'esecuzione delle priorità strategiche in un'organizzazione globale. Lavorare a stretto contatto con gli stakeholder senior in tutte le regioni e le funzioni, gestire le priorità esecutive, coordinare le iniziative chiave, facilitare i processi di leadership e promuovere la collaborazione tra i team. Inoltre, è possibile fornire supporto ai membri del Global Central Team e altri leader senior come esigenze aziendali. Il candidato di successo porterà forti capacità organizzative, giudizio sonoro, attenzione ai dettagli, e un approccio proattivo, orientato alle soluzioni, mantenendo i più alti standard di professionalità, discrezione e riservatezza. Il tuo contributo: Sii te stesso. Sii aperto. Restate a Hungry & Humble. Collaborate. Sfida. Decide & just Do. Questi sono i comportamenti di cui avrete bisogno per il successo a Logitech. In questo ruolo sarete:
• Gestire calendari complessi e riunioni di pianificazione, accordi di viaggio e altri impegni esecutivi, assicurando una ripartizione ottimale del tempo e la priorità di riunioni, appuntamenti e eventi.
• Organizzare la logistica di viaggio nazionale e internazionale, compresi voli, alloggi e trasporto di terra, aderendo alle politiche di bilancio e di viaggio aziendale.
• Preparare e gestire la corrispondenza, le e-mail, i rapporti, le presentazioni e altri documenti secondo le necessità.
• E-mail di bozza e di correzione, memo, presentazioni e altre corrispondenze per conto del Chief Commercial Officer e del team di leadership, garantendo una comunicazione chiara e concisa.
• Coordinate la logistica per le riunioni, preparate gli ordini del giorno e i materiali, prendete i minuti e tracciate le azioni.
• Guidare e coordinare eventi globali e impegni esecutivi dalla pianificazione attraverso l'esecuzione, collaborando con team, fornitori e stakeholder interfunzionali per fornire risultati di successo.
• Assistere con progetti speciali, ricerca, raccolta dati e analisi come richiesto.
• Lavorare come squadra con gli altri assistenti esecutivi esistenti all'interno dell'organizzazione, la comunicazione e il lavoro di squadra sono fondamentali.
• Costruire e mantenere relazioni positive con gli stakeholder interni ed esterni, inclusi clienti, fornitori e altri dipartimenti.
• Elaborare report di spesa, fatture e ordini di acquisto, e assistere con il monitoraggio del budget.
• Possedere un nuovo dipendente a bordo per il nostro team dalla condivisione di informazioni e formazione all'aggiunta di canali di comunicazione per garantire attrezzature e manager di supporto con nuovi dipendenti.
• Diventa una persona di punta per il nostro team per navigare in strumenti e processi interni.
• Assicurarsi che i membri del team siano a conoscenza delle politiche e delle procedure aziendali, nonché delle specifiche linee guida del team.
• Mantenere una rigida riservatezza delle informazioni sensibili e garantire il rispetto delle politiche e delle procedure aziendali.
• Sii flessibile e disposto a viaggiare a livello nazionale e internazionale come necessario per sostenere le priorità esecutive, le attività di leadership, le operazioni aziendali e gli eventi organizzativi chiave.
• Guidare processi ritmici esecutivi di business, tra cui pianificazione trimestrale, leadership offsites e recensioni aziendali.
• Supporta la gestione dei cambiamenti organizzativi e i rollout di comunicazione tra le squadre.
• Facilitare l'allineamento interfunzionale tra i dipartimenti e le squadre globali attraverso le fusi orari.
• Sostenere il coordinamento degli appalti.
• Agire come supporto di backup per altri Assistenti Executive durante le assenze.
• Coordinare le iniziative di riconoscimento interno, le attività di team engagement e gli sforzi per la costruzione della cultura. Key Qua
descriptionByLocale.en:
Logitech is the Sweet Spot for people who want their actions to have a positive global impact while having the flexibility to do it in their own way.

The Role and Team:
We are seeking an experienced, highly organized, and proactive Executive Assistant to support the Chief Commercial Officer, based in Zurich.
This is a highly visible role that combines executive support & business operations. As a trusted partner to the CCO and Leadership Team, you will play a key role in enabling leadership effectiveness, driving operational excellence, and supporting the execution of strategic priorities across a global organization.
Working closely with senior stakeholders across regions and functions, you will manage executive priorities, coordinate key initiatives, facilitate leadership processes, and foster collaboration across teams. In addition, you may provide support to members of the Global Central Team and other senior leaders as business needs require.
The successful candidate will bring strong organizational skills, sound judgment, attention to detail, and a proactive, solutions-oriented approach, while maintaining the highest standards of professionalism, discretion, and confidentiality.

Your Contribution:
Be Yourself. Be Open. Stay Hungry & Humble. Collaborate. Challenge. Decide & just Do. These are the behaviors you’ll need for success at Logitech. In this role you will:

• Manage complex calendars and schedule meetings, travel arrangements, and other executive commitments, ensuring optimal time allocation and prioritization of meetings, appointments, and events.

• Arrange domestic and international travel logistics, including flights, accommodations, and ground transportation, while adhering to budget and company travel policies.

• Prepare and manage correspondence, emails, reports, presentations, and other documents as needed.

• Draft and proofread emails, memos, presentations, and other correspondence on behalf of the Chief Commercial Officer and leadership team, ensuring clear and concise communication.

• Coordinate logistics for meetings, prepare agendas and materials, take minutes, and track action items.

• Lead and coordinate global events and executive engagements from planning through execution, partnering with cross-functional teams, vendors, and stakeholders to deliver successful outcomes.

• Assist with special projects, research, data collection, and analysis as required.

• Work as a team with the other existing executive assistants within the organization, communication & team work are key.

• Build and maintain positive relationships with internal and external stakeholders, including clients, vendors, and other departments..

• Process expense reports, invoices, and purchase orders, and assist with budget tracking.

• Own new employee onboarding for our team from information sharing and training to adding to communication channels to securing equipment and supporting managers with new employees.

• Become a point person for our team to navigate internal tools and processes.

• Ensure that team members are aware of company policies and procedures, as well as any specific team guidelines.

• Maintain strict confidentiality of sensitive information and ensure compliance with company policies and procedures.

• Be flexible and willing to travel domestically and internationally as needed to support executive priorities, leadership activities, business operations, and key organizational events.

• Drive executive rhythm-of-business processes, including quarterly planning, leadership offsites and business reviews.

• Support organizational change management and communication rollouts across teams.

• Facilitate cross-functional alignment between departments and global teams across time zones.

• Support procurement coordination.

• Act as backup support for other Executive Assistants during absences.

• Coordinate internal recognition initiatives, team engagement activities and culture-building efforts.

Key Qua
descriptionByLocale.de:
Logitech ist der Sweet Spot für Menschen, die ihre Handlungen eine positive globale Wirkung haben wollen und gleichzeitig die Flexibilität haben, es auf ihre eigene Weise zu tun. Die Rolle und das Team: Wir suchen einen erfahrenen, hoch organisierten und proaktiven Executive Assistant, der den Chief Commercial Officer mit Sitz in Zürich unterstützt. Dies ist eine sehr sichtbare Rolle, die Executive-Support & Business-Operationen kombiniert. Als vertrauenswürdiger Partner des CCO- und Leadership-Teams spielen Sie eine Schlüsselrolle bei der Umsetzung von Führungswirksamkeit, der operativen Exzellenz und der Unterstützung der Umsetzung strategischer Prioritäten in einer globalen Organisation. In enger Zusammenarbeit mit führenden Akteuren in Regionen und Funktionen werden Sie Führungsprioritäten verwalten, wichtige Initiativen koordinieren, Führungsprozesse erleichtern und die Zusammenarbeit in Teams fördern. Darüber hinaus können Sie den Mitgliedern des Global Central Teams und anderen leitenden Führungskräften Unterstützung bieten, da die Geschäftsanforderungen erforderlich sind. Der erfolgreiche Kandidat wird starke organisatorische Fähigkeiten, fundiertes Urteil, Liebe zum Detail und einen proaktiven, lösungsorientierten Ansatz bringen, wobei die höchsten Standards der Professionalität, Diskretion und Vertraulichkeit eingehalten werden. Ihr Beitrag: Sei selbst. Sei offen. Bleib Hungry & Humble. Zusammenarbeit. Herausforderung. Entscheiden & einfach. Dies sind die Verhaltensweisen, die Sie bei Logitech erfolgreich benötigen. In dieser Rolle wirst du:
• Verwalten Sie komplexe Kalender und Termine, Reisevereinbarungen und andere operative Verpflichtungen, um eine optimale Zeitverteilung und Priorisierung von Treffen, Terminen und Veranstaltungen zu gewährleisten.
• Inlands- und Auslandsreiselogistik, einschließlich Flügen, Unterkünften und Bodentransport, bei gleichzeitiger Einhaltung der Budget- und Firmenreisepolitik.
• Bereiten und verwalten Sie Korrespondenz, E-Mails, Berichte, Präsentationen und andere Dokumente nach Bedarf.
• E-Mails, Memos, Präsentationen und andere Korrespondenz im Auftrag des Chief Commercial Officer und des Führungsteams entwerfen und lesen, um eine klare und präzise Kommunikation zu gewährleisten.
• Koordinierte Logistik für Treffen, Vorbereitung von Tagesordnungen und Materialien, nehmen Sie Minuten und verfolgen Sie Aktionspunkte.
• Führen und koordinieren globale Veranstaltungen und Executive Engagements von der Planung über die Ausführung, die Zusammenarbeit mit funktionsübergreifenden Teams, Anbietern und Stakeholdern, um erfolgreiche Ergebnisse zu erzielen.
• Besteht nach Bedarf mit Sonderprojekten, Forschung, Datenerhebung und Analyse.
• Arbeit als Team mit den anderen vorhandenen Führungskräften innerhalb der Organisation, Kommunikation und Teamarbeit sind der Schlüssel.
• Aufbau und Aufrechterhaltung positiver Beziehungen zu internen und externen Akteuren, einschließlich Kunden, Anbietern und anderen Abteilungen.
• Prozesskostenberichte, Rechnungen und Kaufaufträge und Hilfe beim Budget-Tracking.
• Eigener neuer Mitarbeiter an Bord unseres Teams von Informationsaustausch und Schulung bis hin zu Kommunikationskanälen zur Sicherung von Ausrüstung und Unterstützung von Managern mit neuen Mitarbeitern.
• Werden Sie eine Punktperson für unser Team, um interne Werkzeuge und Prozesse zu navigieren.
• Stellen Sie sicher, dass die Teammitglieder sich der Unternehmenspolitik und -verfahren sowie der spezifischen Teamrichtlinien bewusst sind.
• Bewahren Sie die strenge Vertraulichkeit sensibler Informationen und stellen Sie sicher, dass die Unternehmenspolitiken und -verfahren eingehalten werden.
• Seien Sie flexibel und bereit, im In- und Ausland zu reisen, wenn es erforderlich ist, um Führungsprioritäten, Führungsaktivitäten, Geschäftsvorgänge und wichtige organisatorische Veranstaltungen zu unterstützen.
• Führende Rhythmik-of-Business-Prozesse, einschließlich vierteljährlicher Planung, Führungen und Business-Rezensionen.
• Unterstützung von organisatorischen Change Management und Kommunikations-Rollouts über Teams.
• Erleichterung der funktionsübergreifenden Ausrichtung zwischen Abteilungen und globalen Teams über Zeitzonen.
• Unterstützung der Koordinierung der Auftragsvergabe.
• Aktivieren Sie als Backup-Unterstützung für andere Executive Assistants während der Abwesenheit.
• Koordinierung interner Anerkennungsinitiativen, Teamengagement-Aktivitäten und kulturaufbauende Anstrengungen. Schlüssel Qua
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Logitech est le Sweet Spot pour les personnes qui veulent que leurs actions aient un impact global positif tout en ayant la flexibilité de le faire à leur manière. Rôle et équipe : Nous recherchons un assistant exécutif expérimenté, hautement organisé et proactif pour soutenir le chef de la direction commerciale, basé à Zurich. Il s'agit d'un rôle très visible qui combine le soutien des cadres et les opérations des entreprises. En tant que partenaire de confiance de l'OCC et de l'équipe de leadership, vous jouerez un rôle clé pour favoriser l'efficacité du leadership, stimuler l'excellence opérationnelle et appuyer l'exécution des priorités stratégiques dans une organisation mondiale. En étroite collaboration avec les principaux intervenants de toutes les régions et de toutes les fonctions, vous gérerez les priorités de la direction, coordonnerez les initiatives clés, faciliterez les processus de leadership et favoriserez la collaboration entre les équipes. De plus, vous pouvez fournir un soutien aux membres de l'équipe centrale mondiale et à d'autres dirigeants, selon les besoins des entreprises. Le candidat retenu apportera de solides compétences organisationnelles, un jugement solide, une attention aux détails et une approche proactive axée sur les solutions, tout en maintenant les normes les plus élevées de professionnalisme, de discrétion et de confidentialité. Votre contribution : Soyez vous-même. Soyez ouvert. Restez affamés et humbles. Collaborez. Défi. Décider & juste faire. Ce sont les comportements dont vous aurez besoin pour réussir à Logitech. Dans ce rôle, vous:
• Gérer les calendriers complexes et planifier les réunions, les arrangements relatifs aux voyages et les autres engagements de la direction, en veillant à ce que les réunions, les nominations et les événements soient classés par ordre de priorité de manière optimale.
• Mettre en place une logistique de voyage nationale et internationale, y compris des vols, des logements et des transports terrestres, tout en respectant les politiques budgétaires et de voyage de la compagnie.
• Préparer et gérer la correspondance, les courriels, les rapports, les présentations et d'autres documents au besoin.
• Ébauche et correction de courriels, de notes de service, de présentations et d'autres correspondances au nom du chef du commerce et de l'équipe de direction, assurant une communication claire et concise.
• Coordonner la logistique des réunions, préparer les ordres du jour et les documents, prendre des minutes et suivre les mesures à prendre.
• Diriger et coordonner les manifestations mondiales et les engagements des cadres, depuis la planification jusqu'à l'exécution, en passant par le partenariat avec les équipes interfonctionnelles, les fournisseurs et les parties prenantes pour obtenir des résultats positifs.
• Aider aux projets spéciaux, à la recherche, à la collecte de données et à l'analyse au besoin.
• Travailler en équipe avec les autres assistants exécutifs au sein de l'organisation, la communication et le travail d'équipe sont essentiels.
• Établir et maintenir des relations positives avec les parties prenantes internes et externes, y compris les clients, les fournisseurs et d'autres départements.
• Traiter les rapports de dépenses, les factures et les bons de commande, et aider au suivi du budget.
• Posséder un nouvel employé à bord pour notre équipe, du partage de l'information et de la formation à l'ajout de canaux de communication à la sécurisation de l'équipement et au soutien des gestionnaires avec de nouveaux employés.
• Devenez une personne point pour notre équipe de naviguer dans les outils et les processus internes.
• Veiller à ce que les membres de l'équipe connaissent les politiques et procédures de l'entreprise, ainsi que les lignes directrices de l'équipe.
• Maintenir une stricte confidentialité des informations sensibles et assurer le respect des politiques et procédures de l'entreprise.
• Être flexible et disposé à voyager à l'échelle nationale et internationale au besoin pour appuyer les priorités de la direction, les activités de leadership, les opérations commerciales et les événements organisationnels clés.
• Diriger les processus de rythme d'affaires des cadres, y compris la planification trimestrielle, le leadership hors site et l'examen des affaires.
• Appuyer la gestion du changement organisationnel et le déploiement des communications entre les équipes.
• Faciliter l'alignement interfonctionnel entre les départements et les équipes mondiales dans les fuseaux horaires.
• Appuyer la coordination des achats.
• Agir comme soutien de secours pour les autres assistants exécutifs pendant les absences.
• Coordonner les initiatives de reconnaissance interne, les activités de mobilisation des équipes et les efforts de renforcement de la culture. Qua clé

title: Senior Product Manager - Logitech Video Solutions

titleByLocale.it: Responsabile prodotto senior - Soluzioni video Logitech
titleByLocale.en: Senior Product Manager - Logitech Video Solutions
titleByLocale.de: Senior Product Manager - Logitech Video Solutions
titleByLocale.fr: Gestionnaire de produits senior - Logitech Video Solutions

descriptionByLocale.it:
Logitech is the Sweet Spot for people who want their actions to have a positive global impact while having the flexibility to do it in their own way. Location: Lausanne Working Model: 2-3 days/week in the office The Role and the Team: At Logitech, we don’t just build tools. We bridge the gap between people and the digital world. As the world shifts toward a video-first culture, the "Personal Work Solutions" team is at the epicenter of how humans create together, and project their identity and creativity to the world. We are looking for a Senior Product Manager who views video not as a utility, but as an experience. You will lead the next generation of video solutions, blending cutting-edge hardware with AI-driven software to create world-class solutions serving millions of users in both B2C and B2B. This is an exciting role in a fast paced environment, where the right person can make a huge impact. You’ll be based in Lausanne, Switzerland, part of the Personal Work Solutions (PWS) business group. Your role will be global, with occasional travel across regions. Your Contribution: Be Yourself. Be Open. Stay Hungry and Humble. Collaborate. Challenge. Decide and just Do. Share our passion for Equality and the Environment. These are the behaviors and values you’ll need for success at Logitech. In this role you will:
• Lead the creation, development, and launch of seamless video experiences and innovative webcam solutions leveraging advanced technologies (AI, computer vision, etc.)
• Enable millions of people worldwide to connect, collaborate, and express themselves with confidence
• Maintain Logitech’s #1 global webcam market position, driving breakthrough product launches for measurable business growth and best in class customer satisfaction
• Guide multidisciplinary teams, working closely with Business, Industrial Design, UX, SW & HW Engineering teams to transform ideas and users insights into iconic, industry-defining products, all the way to mass production
• Ensure end-to-end user journey at every touchpoint. Ensuring our solutions work beautifully for diverse global audiences in B2B & B2C, across 50+ countries
• Deeply understand consumer and enterprise needs to generate actionable insights throughout development
• Shape the future of video interaction through advanced technology integration, competitive intelligence, and proactive identification of innovation and white-space opportunities
• Partner with business teams to explore and execute new revenue opportunities through innovative product offerings Key Qualifications For consideration, you must bring the following minimum skills and behaviors to our team:
• 7+ years of demonstrable experience in a product management position, with successful development and launches of software and hardware solutions
• Experience with video technologies and trends, ideally in video hardware
• Proven track record applying the Design Thinking approaches to drive innovation processes and managing complex initiatives from concept to launch, ideally in a hardware/software integrated environment.
• Curiosity and passion for users. Fluent in conducting user tests and qualitative consumer research
• Strong business acumen with passion for consumer electronics
• Curiosity, hands-on engagement, autonomy, and an entrepreneurial mindset
• Strong analytical skills and technical understanding, with ability to communicate effectively with engineers
• Exceptional leadership and communication skills, capable of motivating teams and working effectively across departments.
• Strong written and oral communication skills in English.
• High energy, a positive attitude, and integrity Education
• BA/BS in Business, Engineering, or Design.
• MBA is a plus. #LI-RD1 Across Logitech we empower collaboration and foster play. We help teams collaborate/learn from anywhere, without compromising on productivity or continuity so it should be no surprise that most of our jobs are

Logitech is the Sweet Spot for people who want their actions to have a positive global impact while having the flexibility to do it in their own way. Location : Lausanne, Switzerland Working Model: Hybrid (2-3 days on-site) The Team This is an exciting opportunity to help shape the future of Simulation at Logitech G. You will be working with team members across the globe, many of whom have been working in this fast-growing category for many years. This is a cross-functional team, with expertise in engineering, software, marketing and launch planning, all with the goal of helping sim racers enjoy their chosen hobby or profession. The Role The Product Manager will drive the definition, execution, and delivery of Simulation products used across PC and console. The role includes understanding the simulation category with the ability to identify opportunities and consumer requirements, through a combination of knowledge, intuition, market research, internal feedback and cooperation with our Consumer Insights team. You will be capable of influencing and contributing to the product strategy and roadmap, enhancing its feature set, and working with cross-functional teams to create the products in said roadmap. Succinctly, the product manager’s role is to choose the right product to develop and then work with the team to make sure that the product is right. Your Contribution: Be Yourself. Be Open. Stay Hungry and Humble. Collaborate. Challenge. Decide and just Do. Share our passion for Equality and the Environment. These are the behaviors and values you’ll need for success at Logitech. In this role you will:
• Define and deliver the Logitech simulation product roadmap.
• Develop detailed product requirements for products.
• Collaborate with designers, engineers, and software teams to deliver solutions that meet business and customer needs.
• Work with the Head of Simulation, Marketing and Go-to-market teams to execute a scalable simulation product vision.
• Agreed product strategy with Head of Sim.
• Communication of product benefits and messaging with Marketing.
• Business Case Financials, including forecasting with Go-to-market.
• Creation of user manuals, support FAQs and recommended settings for simulation products, both for new product introductions and as a reaction to issues as part of the product lifecycle monitoring.
• Communicate product status, key issues, and launch plans to stakeholders, including the executive team.
• Continue to monitor products throughout the lifecycle, including issues, consumer feedback etc.
• Manage the day-to-day relationship with first party partners for product submissions and platform changes. Key Qualifications: For consideration, you must bring the following minimum skills and experiences to our team:
• 3-5 years of experience in a similar Product Management or adjacent role.
• Enthusiasm and experience in simulation gaming and/or real world racing/flight is very beneficial, but not a requirement.
• Ability to communicate complicated concepts to both technical and non-technical people.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a data-driven approach to decision-making.
• Ambitious, hands-on, with a can-do attitude.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Logitech è il Sweet Spot per le persone che vogliono che le loro azioni abbiano un impatto globale positivo, pur avendo la flessibilità di farlo a modo loro. Posizione: Zurigo Modello di lavoro: 5 giorni / settimana in ufficio (in loco) Il team e il ruolo: Il Gaming Categoria & Marketing Manager — La Svizzera porterà la nostra esecuzione di marketing su più canali sia online che offline e fornire una migliore esperienza di cliente in classe per i nostri utenti finali. Questa posizione lavorerà a stretto contatto con diverse funzioni all'interno del team regionale, Cluster Categoria Manager, eCommerce Marketing Manager, Account Manager e altri ruoli di supporto per guidare la strategia in azione. Non si tratta solo di fogli di calcolo; si tratta dell’ecosistema esports . Stiamo cercando uno specialista di marketing che vive veramente lo stile di vita di gioco —qualcuno che capisce il pro-circuito, rispetta la comunità , è creativo e appassionato, così come conosce i loro KPI. Il tuo contributo: Sii te stesso. Sii aperto. Restate a Hungry e Humble. Collaborate. Sfida. Condividi la nostra passione per l'uguaglianza e l'ambiente. Questi sono i comportamenti e i valori di cui avrete bisogno per il successo a Logitech. In questo ruolo sarete:
• Sviluppare e condurre un approccio a 360 gradi al viaggio dei consumatori con digitale, PR, sociale, partenariato, punto vendita, localizzazione e altro ancora.
• Sviluppare e condurre strategie digitali che spingono il business ottimizzando il nostro mix di marketing digitale, guidando più traffico alle pagine Etail su più piattaforme.
• Condurre lo sviluppo di POSM di classe migliore e ottimizzare i beni digitali locali per rafforzare la visibilità al dettaglio/etail e la consapevolezza del marchio.
• Possedere intuizioni, reportage e strumenti di marketing, tra cui la configurazione e le misure KPI su ROI, per garantire una misurazione di successo e trarre costantemente intuizioni dai risultati.
• Collaborare con i dipartimenti rilevanti (gruppo regionale / team interno Categoria & Account Manager / Agenzie) per guidare il successo nel business di gioco, identificare i giocatori chiave e coordinare le azioni. Qualifiche chiave: Per considerazione, è necessario portare le seguenti competenze e esperienze minime al nostro team:
• 7+ anni di esperienza nel marketing del prodotto o nella funzione di gestione del marchio del settore dei beni di consumo
• Forte capacità di leadership e confortevole sfidare processi e norme esistenti - Ottima capacità di comunicazione e presentazione con la capacità di influenzare la strategia del marchio in tutta l'organizzazione e con i partner di distribuzione
• Forte capacità di problem solving e decision making basata sull'analisi basata sui dati
• Esperienza nella gestione di P&L: gestione e crescita di una linea di prodotti / redditività della categoria
• Esperienza con piena miscela di vendita e marketing, sviluppo di piani di marketing e 360 campagne - Esperienza approfondita nella comprensione delle preferenze dei clienti, atteggiamenti e altri fattori che influenzano i piani di marketing e le campagne
• Positivo, “Can do, Will do” atteggiamento con indiscutibile integrità
• Capacità di analizzare e comprendere le tendenze di vendita a livello SKU e utilizzare che per sviluppare previsioni e piani di vendita per guidare la crescita
• Capacità di lavorare in modo indipendente e collaborativo in un'organizzazione di matrice, con team diversi, sia funzionale che geograficamente è critica
• -Vivi e respiri la cultura del gioco e dell'esport, dalle storie pro-circuito alle ultime gocce di ingranaggi. Mese Fondazione: Nuovo ruolo, nuovo scenario. Per i tuoi primi 30 giorni, ti troverai a Monaco di Baviera tre giorni alla settimana (lunedì-mercoledì) per imparare, legare e salire alla velocità. Copriamo il viaggio e il soggiorno; porti il talento. È il modo perfetto per velocizzare il vostro impatto. #LI-RD1 Attraverso Logitech siamo in grado di promuovere la collaborazione e il gioco. Aiutiamo i team a collaborare/a partire da qualsiasi luogo, senza compromettere la produttività o la continuità in modo da non sorprendere che la maggior parte dei nostri lavori siano aperti a lavorare da casa dalla maggior parte delle sedi. Il nostro modello di lavoro ibrido permette ad alcuni dipendenti di lavorare da remoto mentre altri lavorano su premi. All'interno di questa struttura

Logitech is the Sweet Spot for people who want their actions to have a positive global impact while having the flexibility to do it in their own way. Location : Zurich Working Model : 5 days/a week in the office (on-site) The Team and Role: The Gaming Category & Marketing Manager — Switzerland will lead our marketing execution across multiple channels both online and offline and deliver a best-in-class customer experience for our end users. This position will work closely with different functions within the Regional Team, Cluster Category Manager, eCommerce Marketing Manager, Account Manager, and other supporting roles to drive the strategy into action. This isn't just about spreadsheets; it’s about the esports ecosystem . We’re looking for a marketing specialist who truly lives the gaming lifestyle —someone who understands the pro-circuit , respects the community , is creative and passionate, as well as knows their KPIs. Your Contribution: Be Yourself. Be Open. Stay Hungry and Humble. Collaborate. Challenge. Decide and just Do. Share our passion for Equality and the Environment. These are the behaviors and values you’ll need for success at Logitech. In this role you will:
• Develop and lead a 360-degree approach to the consumer journey with digital, PR, social, partnership, point of sales, localization, and more.
• Develop and lead digital strategies that drive business by optimizing our digital marketing mix, driving more traffic to Etail pages across multiple platforms.
• Lead the development of best-in-class POSM and optimize local digital assets to strengthen retail/etail visibility and brand awareness.
• Own overall marketing insights, reporting, and tools, including KPIs setup and measures on ROI, to ensure successful measurement and consistently derive insights from results.
• Collaborate with relevant departments (Regional team / Internal Category & Account Manager team / Agencies) to drive success in the gaming business, identify key players, and coordinate actions. Key Qualifications: For consideration, you must bring the following minimum skills and experiences to our team:
• 7+ years of experience in product marketing or brand management function of the consumer goods industry
• Strong leadership skills and comfortable challenging existing processes and norms - Excellent communication and presentation skills with the ability to influence brand strategy across the organization and with distribution partners
• Strong problem solving and decision making ability based on data driven analysis
• Experience in P&L management – managing and successfully growing a product line/category profitability
• Experience with full sales & marketing mix, developing marketing plans and 360 campaigns - In-depth experience in understanding customer preferences, attitudes, and other factors that influence marketing plans and campaigns
• Positive, “Can do, Will do” attitude with unquestionable integrity
• Ability to analyze and understand sales trends at SKU level and use that to develop forecasts and sales plans to drive growth
• Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a matrix organization, with diverse teams, both functionally and geographically is critical
• -You live and breathe gaming and esports culture, from the pro-circuit storylines to the latest gear drops. Foundational Month: New role, new scenery. For your first 30 days, you’ll be based in Munich three days a week (Monday-Wednesday) to learn, bond and get up to speed. We cover the travel and the stay; you bring the talent. It’s the perfect way to fast-track your impact. #LI-RD1 Across Logitech we empower collaboration and foster play. descriptionByLocale.de:
Logitech ist der Sweet Spot für Menschen, die ihre Handlungen eine positive globale Wirkung haben wollen und gleichzeitig die Flexibilität haben, es auf ihre eigene Weise zu tun. Standort : Zürich Arbeitsmodell: 5 Tage/eine Woche im Büro (vor Ort) Das Team und die Rolle: Der Gaming Kategorie & Marketing Manager – die Schweiz führt unsere Marketing-Ausführung über mehrere Kanäle sowohl online als auch offline und liefert ein erstklassiges Kundenerlebnis für unsere Endnutzer. Diese Position wird eng mit verschiedenen Funktionen im Regionalteam, Cluster Category Manager, eCommerce Marketing Manager, Account Manager und anderen unterstützenden Rollen zusammenarbeiten, um die Strategie in Aktion zu bringen. Es geht nicht nur um Tabellenkalkulationen, sondern um das Ökosystem der Esports . Wir sind auf der Suche nach einem Marketing Spezialisten, der wirklich den Gaming-Lifestyle lebt – jemand, der den Pro-Call versteht, die Gemeinschaft respektiert, kreativ und leidenschaftlich ist, sowie ihre KPIs kennt. Ihr Beitrag: Sei selbst. Sei offen. Bleib Hungry und Humble. Zusammenarbeit. Herausforderung. Entscheiden und einfach tun. Teilen Sie unsere Leidenschaft für Gleichheit und Umwelt. Dies sind die Verhaltensweisen und Werte, die Sie bei Logitech erfolgreich benötigen. In dieser Rolle wirst du:
• Entwickeln und führen Sie einen 360-Grad-Ansatz auf die Customer Journey mit Digital, PR, Social, Partnerschaft, Point of Sales, Lokalisierung und mehr.
• Entwickeln und führen Sie digitale Strategien, die das Geschäft durch Optimierung unserer digitalen Marketing-Mix, treiben mehr Verkehr auf Etail-Seiten auf mehreren Plattformen.
• Führen Sie die Entwicklung von best-in-class POSM und optimieren Sie lokale digitale Assets, um die Sichtbarkeit und das Markenbewusstsein im Einzelhandel zu stärken.
• Eigene Gesamt-Marketing-Einsichten, Berichterstattung und Tools, einschließlich KPIs-Setup und Maßnahmen auf dem ROI, um eine erfolgreiche Messung zu gewährleisten und konsequent Erkenntnisse aus Ergebnissen abzuleiten.
• Zusammenarbeit mit relevanten Abteilungen (Regionalteam / Interne Kategorie & Account Manager Team / Agenturen) um den Erfolg im Gaming-Geschäft zu steigern, Schlüsselakteure zu identifizieren und Aktionen zu koordinieren. Schlüsselqualifikationen: Um zu berücksichtigen, müssen Sie folgende Mindestkenntnisse und Erfahrungen in unserem Team mitbringen:
• 7+ Jahre Erfahrung im Produktmarketing oder Markenmanagement der Konsumgüterindustrie
• Starke Führungsfähigkeiten und eine komfortable Herausforderung bestehender Prozesse und Normen - Ausgezeichnete Kommunikations- und Präsentationsfähigkeiten mit der Fähigkeit, die Markenstrategie über die Organisation und mit Vertriebspartnern zu beeinflussen
• Starke Problemlösung und Entscheidungskompetenz auf Basis datengesteuerter Analyse
• Erfahrung im P&L-Management – Management und erfolgreiches Wachstum einer Produktlinie/Kategorie Rentabilität
• Erfahrung mit vollem Vertriebs- & Marketing-Mix, Entwicklung von Marketingplänen und 360 Kampagnen - Tiefe Erfahrung im Verständnis von Kundenpräferenzen, Einstellungen und anderen Faktoren, die Marketingpläne und Kampagnen beeinflussen
• Positive, “Kann tun, Will tun” Haltung mit unerbittlicher Integrität
• Fähigkeit, Umsatztrends auf SKU-Ebene zu analysieren und zu verstehen und zu nutzen, um Prognosen und Verkaufspläne für Wachstum zu entwickeln
• Fähigkeit, unabhängig und kollaborativ in einer Matrix-Organisation zu arbeiten, mit verschiedenen Teams, sowohl funktional als auch geographisch kritisch
• - Sie leben und atmen Gaming und esports Kultur, von der Pro-Clock-Geschichte bis zu den neuesten Gangabfällen. Stiftungsmonat: Neue Rolle, neue Landschaft. Für Ihre ersten 30 Tage werden Sie in München drei Tage in der Woche (Montag-Mittwoch) zu lernen, zu verbinden und zu beschleunigen. Wir decken die Reise und den Aufenthalt; Sie bringen das Talent. Es ist der perfekte Weg, um Ihre Auswirkungen schnell zu verfolgen. #LI-RD1 Über Logitech stärken wir die Zusammenarbeit und fördern das Spiel. Wir helfen Teams, von überall zusammenzuarbeiten, ohne auf Produktivität oder Kontinuität zu verzichten, also sollte es keine Überraschung sein, dass die meisten unserer Arbeitsplätze offen sind, von zu Hause aus zu arbeiten. Unser hybrides Arbeitsmodell ermöglicht es einigen Mitarbeitern, remote zu arbeiten, während andere an Prämissen arbeiten. Innerhalb dieser Struktur
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Logitech est le Sweet Spot pour les personnes qui veulent que leurs actions aient un impact global positif tout en ayant la flexibilité de le faire à leur manière. Lieu : Zurich Modèle de travail : 5 jours/une semaine au bureau (sur place) L'équipe et le rôle : The Gaming Category & Marketing Manager — Suisse dirigera notre exécution marketing sur plusieurs canaux en ligne et hors ligne et offrira une expérience client de qualité pour nos utilisateurs finaux. Ce poste travaillera en étroite collaboration avec différentes fonctions au sein de l'équipe régionale, gestionnaire de la catégorie des grappes, gestionnaire du marketing électronique, gestionnaire de compte, et d'autres rôles d'appui pour mettre la stratégie en pratique. Il ne s'agit pas seulement de tableurs, mais de l'écosystème des sports. Nous sommes à la recherche d'un spécialiste du marketing qui vit vraiment le style de vie du jeu — quelqu'un qui comprend le pro-circuit, respecte la communauté, est créatif et passionné, ainsi que connaît leurs KPI. Votre contribution : Soyez vous-même. Soyez ouvert. Restez affamés et humbles. Collaborez. Défi. Décider et juste faire. Partager notre passion pour l'égalité et l'environnement. Ce sont les comportements et les valeurs dont vous aurez besoin pour réussir à Logitech. Dans ce rôle, vous:
• Développer et diriger une approche à 360 degrés du parcours des consommateurs avec le numérique, les relations publiques, le social, le partenariat, le point de vente, la localisation, etc.
• Concevoir et diriger des stratégies numériques qui stimulent les entreprises en optimisant notre mix marketing numérique, conduisant plus de trafic vers les pages Etail sur plusieurs plateformes.
• Diriger le développement de POSM de première classe et optimiser les atouts numériques locaux pour renforcer la visibilité et la notoriété de la marque.
• Posséder des idées, des rapports et des outils de marketing, y compris la mise en place d'ICK et des mesures sur le ROI, afin d'assurer une mesure réussie et d'obtenir systématiquement des idées sur les résultats.
• Collaborer avec les départements concernés (équipe régionale/équipe interne de gestion de la catégorie et des comptes/agences) pour stimuler le succès dans le domaine du jeu, identifier les acteurs clés et coordonner les actions. Qualités clés : Pour considération, vous devez apporter les compétences et expériences minimales suivantes à notre équipe:
• 7 ans et plus d'expérience en marketing de produits ou en gestion de marques dans l'industrie des biens de consommation
• Fortes compétences en leadership et confortable défiant les processus et normes existants - Excellentes compétences en communication et en présentation avec la capacité d'influencer la stratégie de marque dans l'ensemble de l'organisation et avec les partenaires de distribution
• Forte capacité de résolution de problèmes et de prise de décision basée sur l'analyse des données
• Expérience en gestion des P&L – gestion et croissance réussie d'une gamme de produits/catégorie de rentabilité
• Expérience de la combinaison complète des ventes et du marketing, développement de plans marketing et de 360 campagnes - Expérience approfondie de la compréhension des préférences, attitudes et autres facteurs qui influencent les plans marketing et les campagnes
• Positif, peut faire, va faire l'attitude avec une intégrité incontestable
• Capacité d'analyser et de comprendre les tendances des ventes au niveau de l'UGS et d'utiliser celles-ci pour élaborer des prévisions et des plans de ventes pour stimuler la croissance
• La capacité de travailler de façon indépendante et en collaboration dans une organisation matricielle, avec des équipes diverses, tant sur le plan fonctionnel que géographique, est essentielle;
• -Vous vivez et respirez la culture du jeu et de l'esport, des histoires pro-circuitées aux dernières gouttes de vitesse. Mois de fondation : Nouveau rôle, nouveau décor. Pour vos 30 premiers jours, vous serez basé à Munich trois jours par semaine (lundi-mercredi) pour apprendre, se lier et se lever à la vitesse. Nous couvrons le voyage et le séjour; vous apportez le talent. C'est la façon parfaite d'accélérer votre impact. Je ne sais pas. Partout dans Logitech, nous autonomisons la collaboration et favorisons le jeu. Nous aidons les équipes à collaborer/apprendre de n'importe où, sans compromettre la productivité ou la continuité, il ne devrait donc pas être surprenant que la plupart de nos emplois soient ouverts au travail de la maison depuis la plupart des endroits. Notre modèle de travail hybride permet à certains employés de travailler à distance tandis que d'autres travaillent sur site. Dans cette structure

descriptionByLocale.it:
Logitech is the Sweet Spot for people who want their actions to have a positive global impact while having the flexibility to do it in their own way. The role and team: Logitech is looking for an experienced Software Project Manager to join our Software Organization. If you are passionate about revolutionizing the personal workspace and building tools that enhance daily productivity, this is the place for you. You will be the driving force behind the software that powers Logitech’s world-class desktop and mobile applications, ensuring an exceptional, seamless experience for millions of users worldwide. Working in a fast-paced, highly collaborative environment, you will bridge the gap between strategy and execution. You will also help drive the evolution of software development by leveraging AI to reshape the way we work. By partnering closely with Engineering, QA, Embedded Software, Product Management, and Design, you will help shape the future of how people work, create, and connect. Your Contribution: Be Yourself. Be Open. Stay Hungry and Humble. Collaborate. Challenge. Decide and just Do. Share our passion for Equality and the Environment. These are the behaviors and values you’ll need for success at Logitech. In this role you will: Project Execution & Delivery
• Own and manage project schedules, deliverables, and the end-to-end software product life cycle.
• Actively identify project risks and develop creative mitigation and contingency plans to keep projects on track.
• Champion processes and tools that standardize software development, continuously identifying inefficiencies and implementing smart improvements. ​ Cross-Functional Collaboration & Strategy
• Partner closely with Product Owners to manage backlogs, prioritize requests, and deliver best-in-class software experiences that elevate our hardware.
• Build strong, trusting relationships with key stakeholders across Design, Product Marketing, Engineering, and QA.
• Provide clear, regular communication and status reports to stakeholders and Business Group leaders, thoughtfully escalating risks during management and Gate reviews. Agile Leadership & Scrum Mastery
• Act as the Scrum Master for multiple teams, championing the Scrum framework and guiding teams in agile best practices.
• Drive and coordinate essential agile ceremonies, including backlog grooming, sprint planning, demos, retrospectives, and daily stand-ups.
• Proactively resolve issues and remove obstacles so your teams can focus on delivering high-quality work. Key Qualifications: For consideration, you must bring the following minimum skills and experiences to our team:
• Experience: 5+ years of Software Project Management experience in the consumer electronics or tech industry, with demonstrated expertise in project management methodologies.
• Agile Expertise: Certified Scrum Master (CSM) with at least 1 year of active, hands-on Scrum practice and a deep understanding of Scrum principles.
• Technical Acumen: A solid grasp of the intersection between hardware, embedded software (firmware), and application software.
• AI Integration: Demonstrated understanding of AI and how it can benefit software development, transform day-to-day workflows, and drive increases in both efficiency and quality.
• User-Centric Mindset: Deep empathy for user needs, a passion for productivity tools, and a relentless commitment to software quality.
• Execution: Exceptional organizational, planning, and self-management skills.
• Communication: Outstanding verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to interact, influence, negotiate, and collaborate effectively across global geographies and all levels of management. ​ Preferred Qualifications:
• Project Management Professional (PMP) certification.
• Experience working closely with firmware and hardware products. Education:
• A BS/MS in Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience.
• Prior experience working as a so
